delivery.fulfillment-order-not-found: The fulfillment order was not found
delivery.not-paid: This order is not awaiting fulfilment
delivery.not-processing: This order is not ready to ship
delivery.not-shippable: This fulfillment order cannot ship right now
delivery.not-physical: This fulfillment order has nothing to ship — fulfil it instead
delivery.not-digital: This fulfillment order has physical items — ship it instead of fulfilling it
delivery.lines-invalid: The lines name a product that is not here, or more than remains
delivery.not-holdable: Only an open fulfillment order can be put on hold
delivery.not-releasable: This fulfillment order is not on hold, or waits for stock and is released only by it arriving
delivery.not-deliverable: This shipment has already been delivered, or its order cannot take a delivery now

email-shipped.subject: Your order is on its way
email-shipped.body: Good news — part of your order has left the warehouse.
email-shipped.added-subject: The tracking code of your shipment is ready
email-shipped.added-body: The tracking code for part of your order was not available when it left. Here it is.
email-shipped.corrected-subject: The tracking code of your shipment changed
email-shipped.corrected-body: We sent you a tracking code for part of your order that was wrong. This is the right one.
email-shipped.more: {{count}} more items will follow in another shipment.

email-delivered.subject: Your shipment has arrived
email-delivered.withdraw-until: You may withdraw from the purchase until the end of {{date}}.

email-hold-notice.meta-title: Part of your order is on hold

check_address.subject: Please check the delivery address of your order
check_address.body: We could not send part of your order yet because we need you to check its delivery address. Open your order and tell us if anything is wrong.

delayed.subject: Part of your order is delayed
delayed.body: Part of your order is held back for a moment and will leave later than planned. You may cancel it at any time before it ships, and you will be refunded in full.

moved.subject: Part of your order will arrive later than planned
moved.body: The items below were promised for {{agreed}}. They are now expected on {{expected}}.

cleared.subject: Part of your order is delayed
cleared.body: The items below were promised for {{agreed}}. We do not have a new date for them yet; we will write to you when we do.

passed.subject: Part of your order is late
passed.body: The items below were promised for {{agreed}}, and the stock we ordered has not reached us yet. We cannot give you a new date yet.

email-fulfillment-delayed.cancel-any-time: You can cancel it from your order page at any time before it ships, and you will be refunded in full. If you are happy to wait, you do not need to do anything.

delivery.not-reopenable: These units cannot be sent again: the order did not ship that many, or is no longer in a state a replacement can leave from
delivery.not-losable: Only a parcel that has left and not arrived can be reported lost or damaged
delivery.lost-superseded: This parcel cannot be recorded as arrived: its items were already sent again or cancelled

email-lost.meta-title: Part of your order did not reach you

lost.subject: A parcel of your order was lost
lost.body: We are sorry: a parcel with the items below was lost on the way to you.

damaged.subject: A parcel of your order was damaged
damaged.body: We are sorry: a parcel with the items below was damaged on the way to you, so we cannot deliver it.

email-lost.promise: We will send it again, or refund you if you prefer. You do not need to do anything.
email-lost.owed: We have to restock part of it; these items are expected around {{date}}:
